amp.notes: Verses zacht en clean/arpeggiated; choruses en bridge hard met distortion. Verse 3 weer zacht tot het einde.

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.content:
G                              B
When you were here before, couldn't look you in the eyes
                    C                         Cm
You're just like an angel, your skin makes me cry

I wish I was special, you're so fucking special
